usage: Use 古典音樂 to talk about classical music as a general genre, from Western orchestral works to solo piano pieces.
It is a formal, neutral noun, so it fits well in school, concert, and music-app contexts.
Common collocations include 聽古典音樂, 古典音樂會, and 古典音樂作曲家.
For beginners, this word is broader than a single song style: it refers to a whole music tradition, not pop or rock.
